summary: You cut one longer document three ways: fixed windows with overlap, whole sentences and sections. You look at what each does to sentences and headings, measure what overlap costs in tokens, and run a first retrieval check.
goal: Cut a long document three ways and compare the pieces.

items.text: Run compare_strategies.py and match the three summary lines
Change the overlap to 0 and 40 and check the chunk and token counts
Call fixed_windows with an overlap as big as the window and read the error
Check retrieval for 3 questions and fill in the strategy table in your own words
Write the five tests and commit
Play the Chunk Cutter game to the end and see your score
